title: Quick German Sausage Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish made with German sausages, onions, and bell peppers. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the German sausages to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until the sausages are cooked through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
